$comment: Icon sources fetched by `npm run icons:update`.
Defaults point at the bundles behind aws-icons.com, gcpicons.com and az-icons.com
(all three are IcePanel sites serving from icon.icepanel.io). One request per
cloud instead of hundreds of per-file requests.
Heads-up: as of this writing every file in that CDN carries a 2023-04-17
last-modified date, so it is a frozen snapshot rather than a moving feed.
`officialUpstream` records where each vendor publishes the icons that DO
receive updates, for manual cross-checking when the snapshot goes stale.
